meta.title: Website Design Projects Kerala & GCC | Teknoppy Portfolio
meta.description: Business and corporate website projects built by Teknoppy for clients in Kerala, the UAE and Qatar, each linked to a full case study.

body.html: Business and corporate websites Teknoppy has designed and built, from single-page sites through to multi-department platforms with dozens of pages and several content types. Each one was structured around the client's actual sales process rather than a template, which is why an industrial supplier's site and a personal brand site here look nothing alike. The projects below span Kerala and the GCC — follow any card for the full write-up and the results behind it.

sections.intro: Further website projects delivered for Kerala clients.

paragraphs.html: Design and build on every project here was led by the same senior team, not rotated between freelancers. Most started as a web design engagement and grew — corporate site builds, business websites and UI/UX design often run together on the same brief.

Results, rankings and traffic figures for these projects live on the Case Studies page, so this portfolio stays focused on the work itself. For more on the people delivering it, see Leadership and Certifications.

items.q: What kinds of websites has Teknoppy built?
items.a: Corporate sites, industrial and manufacturing sites, education and consultancy sites, personal brand sites, and multi-department platforms. Browse the projects above for live examples close to your own industry.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Kerala?
items.a: Yes. Alongside Kerala clients, several projects here were delivered for businesses in the UAE and Qatar.
